predecessors.name: Kalmar Union
predecessors.text: the union's Norway, which Karl Knutsson of Sweden had held 1449-1450

successors.name: Kalmar Union
successors.text: the whole realm of Christian I once he is king of Sweden as well

rulers.name: Christian I
rulers.title: king of Denmark (1448), Norway (1450) and Sweden (1457)

ledger.x: 2 August 1450: Christian I of Oldenburg is crowned king of Norway at Trondheim.
1458: the Oldenburg row ends and the three crowns are one realm again.

wars.name: Contest for Norway between Christian I and Karl Knutsson
wars.outcome: Karl was crowned at Trondheim on 20 November 1449 and forced to renounce Norway in June 1450; Christian was crowned there on 2 August 1450.

certainty.note: The row carries no territory; the realm's frontiers are those of the Kalmar Union, approximate in the north.
